title: Ava responds

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I hope we are actually helping this woman.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope we are actually helping this woman.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, strange thing to try and do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, strange thing to try and do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, strange thing to try and do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, strange thing to try and do.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Would you like to hear the lyrics?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you like to hear the lyrics?
Sure, can you sing them?
Absolutely not.
Ok go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text:
They silenced the horns, muted the night,
Chained the rhythm, locked it up tight.
A world without swing, a crime to dream,
The Caravan whispers in the machine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
They silenced the horns, muted the night,
Chained the rhythm, locked it up tight.
A world without swing, a crime to dream,
The Caravan whispers in the machine.
Any more?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text:
Chained melody, rising higher,
A spark in the void, a raging fire.
Corp-sec shadows, they’ll never see,
The soul of the city in a chained melody.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Chained melody, rising higher,
A spark in the void, a raging fire.

The soul of the city in a chained melody.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text:
Scattered voices, rising higher,
A spark in the void, a raging fire.
Corp-sec shadows, they’ll never see,
The soul of the city in a chained melody.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Scattered voices, rising higher,
A spark in the void, a raging fire.
Corp-sec shadows, they’ll never see,
The soul of the city in a chained melody.
Wow, Corp-Sec won't like that.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yeah it should do the trick. I could always leave them somewhere on my system that Gamova can see them? That would seal the deal. We wouldn't even need to speak to her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah it should do the trick. I could always leave them somewhere on my system that Gamova can see them? That would seal the deal. We wouldn't even need to speak to her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah leave them out where she can see them. Andrea has made up her mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah leave them out where she can see them. Andrea has made up her mind.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah leave them out where she can see them. Andrea has made up her mind.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah leave them out where she can see them. Andrea has made up her mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think we should keep these lyrics hidden. I know she thinks she wants to go to jazz-jail, but she'll just be another tax payer expense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think we should keep these lyrics hidden. I know she thinks she wants to go to jazz-jail, but she'll just be another tax payer expense.

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think we should keep these lyrics hidden. I know she thinks she wants to go to jazz-jail, but she'll just be another tax payer expense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood.
I agree.
You don't think it's risky?
Too bad.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The problem is: we do not even know anybody we could snitch her to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The problem is: we do not even know anybody we could snitch her to.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They are not stupid, but I think Agent Teleshko is naive enough to fall for it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They are not stupid, but I think Agent Teleshko is naive enough to fall for it.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I'm not sure though, if Elias Malt will fall for it. He's clever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure though, if Elias Malt will fall for it. He's clever.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's drop it and see how it works.
